snippet.title: RACCOIN: Chaos Max Edition – Pre-order Trailer – Nintendo Switch 2
snippet.description:
RACCOIN: Chaos Max Edition launches November 10, 2026 on Nintendo Switch 2. Pre-order and download the demo today: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/raccoin-chaos-max-edition-switch-2/?utm_campaign=A1013-01&utm_id=A1013-01&utm_medium=soytnoa&utm_source=SW

RACCOIN is a roguelike deckbuilder where you combine special coins with powerful items to trigger wildly satisfying combos. Stack shiny towers, spin the lucky wheel, and shake the machine until all the coins drop!

#IndieWorld #RACCOIN

Visit Nintendo.com for more info: https://ninten.do/6008Spp2s
